verdict.rationale: A single community comment (2016) says the official vue-cli can scaffold projects with Vue's official libraries, so an official Vue CLI exists. The only first-party support is a bare 'Tooling Guide' doc title with no CLI details, and nothing shows the CLI serving AI-native or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the CLI's commands and current status, AI- or agent-oriented CLI features such as non-interactive or machine-readable output, and recent hands-on corroboration.
